summary:
Research of w202 (spec-integration r44) done; notes.md has parts 1-7.
The accepted scenario is unbound: no test module runs features/spec-integration.feature (820 deselected, run).
Today the integrate round's result is read for `changes` only; request lines would be dropped (supervise_rounds.py run_round).
The brief has no upstream or request-lines form and does not read spec/index.md (supervise_brief.py integrate_lines, read list).
spec/index.md naming an upstream is accepted and ignored by model check (probe, run); its form is undefined in the repo.
Probe of work request: --source from a non-upstream asker writes q1 (D1); --raised-for is unrecognized (D2), both run.
The round input is an initiative, not the note the scenario and skill name (a reading to settle).
I ran `tools map` by mistake (whole suite, 145 tests); tests-of answers are as old as d2c91c3c.
No test asserts the old one-output behaviour; test_agents.py and test_supervise_change.py are sound.
File set: agents/initiative-round.md, skills/integrating-a-proposal/SKILL.md, scripts/supervise_brief.py, scripts/supervise_rounds.py, plus two new test files.
